ru.label: Русский

ru.intro: Создаём архитектуру бизнеса, имени, продукта и смысла, которая позволяет им развиваться как единой системе — и готовит их к эпохе AI.
ru.selectedIntro: Три разных задачи. Один способ увидеть новую конфигурацию возможностей.
caseSub: Персональный заказ → общая партия → персональный результат

Три действия связываются единым операционным контуром.

Массовое участие и экономические стимулы могут стать частью экологической стратегии.
Объединить экологическую цель, мотивацию и коммуникационную архитектуру.
Авторская концепция вовлечения; подробный механизм не раскрывается.

Единый язык, визуальный и смысловой характер.
Связь имени, продуктов, аудиторий и ценности.

Межкультурная система бренда и локализация.

en.label: English
en.hero: We do not fit your future into the architecture of the past.
en.intro: We design business, naming, product and meaning as one evolving system — built for the age of AI.
en.selectedIntro: Three distinct challenges. One way of discovering new configurations of value.
caseTitle: A name as an operating system
caseSub: Personal order → shared batch → personal outcome
cases: Names are often separated from the internal logic of a product.
A name can become a concise map of an entire system.
KLEOS encodes a sequence of actions in its name.
KRYTOSA recognises limitations; LIBERA liberates; EXPANSA expands; OS connects the processes.
The structure of the name tells the product story.
Three actions are connected by one operating layer.
A common language for team, product and communications; commercial impact has not been measured.
One semantic architecture for individual and team programmes.
Custom tailoring and large production runs are usually treated as separate models.
Customer measurements and preferences can be collected before production.
Personal orders can coexist with serial production.
Remote body measurements, sizes, materials, colours and ornaments; aggregation of orders.
One design, your individuality.
Batch scenarios of 100, 1,000 and 10,000, not actual orders.
Potential economies of scale and market expansion; economics, measurements and logistics need validation.
Multiple markets and manufacturers could participate once the model is validated.
Managing pike-perch populations in Issyk-Kul relates to conserving valued fish species.
Participation and economic incentives could support an ecological strategy.
Connect the ecological objective, motivation and communication architecture.
An original participation concept; detailed mechanisms are not disclosed.
Individual participation in a shared objective.
Conceptual links between ecology, participation and economics.
Potential social and economic effects require separate assessment.
Scaling depends on ecological validation, fishing rules and a confirmed model.
svcText: Naming, meaning, phonetics and preliminary checks.
A coherent verbal and visual identity.
Connect names, products, audiences and value.
Website, communications and market launch architecture.
Cross-cultural brand architecture and localisation.
Terms, meanings and relationships.
Formal model of entities, classes and relationships.
Connected enterprise data and knowledge.
A foundation for future AI integrations.
Adapt the proposition to target markets.
en.methodText: We examine the structure and constraints of a challenge, then design new relationships between existing and undervalued elements. Visual form makes these relationships understandable.
en.marketText: Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, China and international markets. Language, project market and currency are independent choices. Cultural adaptation and native-language review are part of the work.
en.priceText: Pricing depends on project market, scope, scale and localisation. The assessment identifies the likely scope; the final quote is agreed individually.
en.payText: Payment details and available currencies are agreed in the individual proposal. Online payment is not connected yet.
en.about: YISHU (艺术, Yìshù) means art: the art of creating business. We connect business logic, brand, semantics and knowledge architecture. YISHU is part of ROOT FRONTIER SYSTEMS.
form: Complete the fields. Your email app will open; send the message yourself.
en.notice: Original concepts and developments, not verified external client outcomes.
